items.title: Flagship在英國設立生技新創據點
items.summary: Flagship將投入1億英鎊，在英國成立專注於人類與地球健康的「AI原生平台公司」。

items.title: 新創公司募資1.73億美元，鎖定鐮狀細胞疾病治療
STAT+: After death in 基因療法 trial for a brain disease, progress is reported
items.summary: An unexpected patient death rattled researchers who sought to pierce the blood-brain barrier. Now some think they have a better way of mitigating risks.

items.title: Faith-based addiction recovery groups don’t often get federal funding. RFK Jr. wants to change that
items.summary: As RFK Jr. pushes federal support for faith-based recovery groups, medical experts express concern over access to addiction medications.

items.title: Marrow sets out to challenge genetic medicines for severe blood diseases
items.summary: Armed with $173 million in venture funding, the startup is developing what it’s positioning as a more accessible alternative to 基因療法 and gene editing treatments for sickle cell and beta thalassemia.

items.title: J&J bets $2.2B on Ollin’s vision loss drug
items.summary: The deal hands J&J a treatment that could complement its existing eye care franchise, but would vie for share of a crowded and competitive market.

items.title: Lilly adds to buyout streak with $1.5B purchase of startup Calytrix
items.summary: Lilly’s 15th announced acquisition this year — by far the most in the biopharmaceutical sector — centers around a precision therapy for rare blood disorders known as myeloproliferative neoplasms.

items.title: Big-name investors pour $100M into DNA therapeutics developer Seawolf
items.summary: The startup, which also just disclosed an up to $1.2 billion partnership with Sanofi, is backed by Versant, MPM BioImpact, Eli Lilly and Novartis’ venture arm.
